title: CrossYield
tagline: CrossYield is like modern Laxmi chit fund but no scams, just real USDC growth from top DeFi yields.
description:
What is CrossYield?

CrossYield is a Defi platform that finds, deploys, monitors, and rebalances optimal USDC strategies across top chains, powered by historical machine learning, Pyth oracle safety, and a novel AI multi-agent coordination system. 

What is the need of Cross Yield?

Most yield farms are single chain, slow or rule driven. We use real cross chain execution (via CCTP), real-time oracles, ML predicted APY, automated rebalancing, and agentic AI for best in class safety and returns.
how_its_made:
At the core of CrossYield lies a USDC yield optimizer powered by a sophisticated AI layer written in Python. It integrates CCTP and 1inch for seamless cross-chain operations and converting rewards back into USDC.

We’ve built our smart contracts in Solidity to abstract away complexity for users, while the frontend is written in TypeScript and developed on top of Next.js.

Our partners played a crucial role in powering the AI—using Pyth and The Graph, we can identify the best USDC yields possible. 1inch enables efficient swaps of rewards back into USDC, ensuring users enjoy effortless yields without the hassle
